D01.ratified: Only an authorized human in a restricted administrative environment can administer Directors

D02.ratified: Human act must have linked evidence; no automatic approval
D02.ops02: Document digest and binding only; referenced evidence bytes and authenticity not verified

D03.ratified: Manual substitution, multiple legitimate Directors allowed; no automatic transfer
D03.ops02: Individual intentions only; no succession flow

D04.ratified: New authorized human act; no reuse of I85 bootstrap
D04.ops02: No recovery execution or bootstrap invocation

D05.ratified: Existing effective competence and session revocation preserved
D05.ops02: No interference with existing SQL/Auth or revocation

CapabilityTests: no privileged CLI or workflow services

execution_evidence: Actual counts, failures, skips, commit/tree, inventory and results belong to immutable CI logs/artifacts and final delivery; this file does not predeclare success or self-reference the future commit.
limits: No proof of human presence or organizational authority
Capability inspection is a reviewable regression control, not a sandbox against arbitrary replaced code

future_interfaces.Frontend: Ordinary approved ports only; no authority inferred from UI or role
future_interfaces.OpenAI: No privileged credentials or Director-administration tool
future_interfaces.infrastructure: Future nominal human channel requires new decision and authorization

next_possible_mission: Owner decision for D01/D02 and specification of nominal administrative access and external evidence custody; no execution authorized by OPS02
